head_commit.message:
Fixed status output to use auth information from AuthManager (#6529)

This PR addresses https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/6360. The root
problem is that the TUI was directly loading the `auth.json` file to
access the auth information. It should instead be using the AuthManager,
which records the current auth information. The `auth.json` file can be
overwritten at any time by other instances of the CLI or extension, so
its information can be out of sync with the current instance. The
`/status` command should always report the auth information associated
with the current instance.

An alternative fix for this bug was submitted by @chojs23 in [this
PR](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/6495). That approach was only a
partial fix.

its information can be out of sync with the current instance. The
`/status` command should always report the auth information associated
with the current instance.

An alternative fix for this bug was submitted by @chojs23 in [this
PR](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/6495). That approach was only a
partial fix.

head_commit.message:
Implement MCP tool call handling with approval mechanism

This update introduces a new `McpHandler` that utilizes `ToolOrchestrator` and `McpRuntime` to manage MCP tool calls. The `run` method now constructs a `McpToolCallRequest` and processes it through the orchestrator, handling errors with a dedicated `map_tool_error` function. Additionally, a new test case is added to ensure that MCP calls require approval when requested, validating the approval flow and response handling.

Changes include:
- Refactoring of MCP tool call handling in `mcp.rs`
- Addition of `McpToolCallRequest` struct
- Implementation of approval logic in the test suite

This enhances the functionality and robustness of the MCP tool integration.
